programme.title: Eredivisie file
programme.desc: The third episode focuses on the header. No less than 15% of all goals in the Eredivisie are scored with the head. Of all ball contacts during a football match, on average 7.7% are with the head. This means that during 1 Eredivisie season no fewer than 28,000 heads are made. It has also been known for years that heading is not good for your health. It increases the risk of ALS, Parkinson's disease and dementia. – The third episode focuses on the header. programme.title: Wild sky – Africa | S01E03
programme.desc: The authors observe how animals living in different parts of the world have adapted to weather conditions. Viewers will see what survival mechanisms have been developed by representatives of the fauna of Africa, Australia and other continents when exposed to the scorching sun, strong winds and heavy rains. The essence of life for African animals is the constant search for water. Viewers will see, among others: spectacular sea feasts and cobras basking in the sun. Herds of wildebeest and elephants migrate. Great Britain. 2025. nature series

programme.title: Wild Sky – South America | S01E04
programme.desc: The authors observe how animals living in different parts of the world have adapted to weather conditions. programme.title: David Attenborough and the sea fig
programme.desc: A 200-million-year-old ichthyosaur skeleton was discovered on the coast of Great Britain. Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Dry savanna | E01
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Lions' prey tend to feed when the hunters are resting - the hottest time of the day. The increase in temperature affects the behavior of animals living in these hot areas. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Leopard, sand and heat | E02
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Leopards live in thousands of ecosystems, from the rainforests of India to the driest regions of Africa; they adapt to almost any climate, feeding on over 100 different species. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Cheetahs on a hot plain | E03
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. A slender build, black spots on light fur, hyperventilation and regular licking to evaporate saliva - these are the cheetah's most effective tricks to help it survive in high temperatures. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life – Lycaons in difficult terrain | E04
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Most species living in extreme conditions delay their reproductive cycles; Lycaons speed up this process so that their young are born before the hottest period. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Africa: hot life - Caracals and bush fire | E05
programme.desc: Almost all wild inhabitants of hot regions of the world, such as Africa, are at risk of extinction due to climate change. The authors wonder whether and to what extent they will be able to adapt to new, difficult living conditions. Caracals live in terrain where the ground and vegetation are the same color; they are quiet and can disappear from sight: they are true masters of camouflage, as well as specialists in life in the desert and savannah. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Fall | E01
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. It's fall in Canada, and the cold winter will soon begin. The animals have little time: they must make the most of the available food before it disappears under the deep snow and ice. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Winter | E02
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Canada is covered in ice and snow. The animals are going through a difficult time right now: beavers are eating the food they collected in autumn, and arctic foxes are looking for food wherever they can. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Spring | E03
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Spring in Canada is a time when most animals breathe a sigh of relief after a cold winter. Unfortunately, spring is late this year. When it finally comes, there will be little time left to start a family. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Four Seasons – Summer | E04
programme.desc: The second largest country in the world, Canada, is home to a variety of animals adapted to living in a harsh climate. They include hardworking beavers, polar bears, and small frogs. The everyday life of representatives of the local fauna is the source of many natural curiosities. Summer is a time of abundance for most animals - but not for polar bears. These predators cannot hunt seals until the sea freezes over. They are getting hungrier every day. Great Britain. 2018. documentary series

programme.title: Canada: Survive in the wild North
programme.desc: Canada has the world's largest area of ​​intact primeval forest, over two million lakes and rivers, and the longest coastline on Earth. This wild and rugged area is inhabited by many fascinating wild animals. These include bears, arctic foxes, wolves, Canadian lynxes, flying owls, great owls, caribou and seals. Viewers will see how fauna copes in such difficult conditions to survive, taking advantage of the opportunities offered to representatives of different species in each season... His passion, intensity and vehemence have marked European basketball for more than thirty years. Zeljko Obradovic was a world champion as a player with a legendary Yugoslav team before making an early move to the bench. It was in 1991, with Partizan Belgrade, the team of his life. His first season he was already European champion. Joventut, Real Madrid, Treviso, Panathinaikos and Fenerbahçe later saw him triumph. Along the way he has marked the lives and careers of hundreds of players. Many call him teacher. Obradovic returned home, to Partizan, where they adore him. As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: MY RUN, MY WAY
programme.desc: Tập đầu tiên của 'My Run, My Way' bắt đầu dọc theo con đường Yeongdeok Blue tuyệt đẹp. Một chuyến đi độc đáo nơi Đại dương xanh, gió biển và mồ hôi của mọi người chạy đều tạo ra những khoảnh khắc khó quên.

programme.title: VÕ TÒNG BÁO THÙ - WUSONG VS XIMENQING
programme.desc: Wu Song phát hiện ra về mối tình chị dâu của anh ấy với một người đàn ông giàu có, Ximen Qing. Qing đặt bài hát lên và anh ta bị lưu đày trong một năm, trong đó người anh trai bất hạnh của anh ta bị sát hại và hỏa táng. Khi Song cuối cùng trở về nhà, anh ta đưa vụ án ra tòa nhưng thẩm phán gạt nó sang một bên và đóng nó một cách đột ngột. Cuối cùng, bài hát có thể trả thù cho anh trai của mình cái chết không?

programme.desc: 18 năm trước, gia tộc Feather Black Feather đã xâm nhập vào lãnh thổ của Master Fire Cloud và lấy trộm mặt nạ của Shura, do đó giải phóng một linh hồn xấu xa là một em bé. Khi em bé lớn lên, anh ta nắm quyền kiểm soát mặt nạ và trở thành người kế nhiệm Fire Cloud, với tư cách là người bảo vệ thành phố.

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ lính nữ ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị lực lượng đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thách thức trên khắp đất liền, biển và không khí. Những người bảo vệ nữ hàng đầu tạo thành các đội bốn người để cạnh tranh với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cuối cùng trước sáu chủ nhà nổi tiếng!
